title: Skill
description: One skill: a class skill (45 per class, 3 schools × 5 tiers × 3; the sheets in docs/classes/), a field skill, a pet active, or a monster-only skill (03-GAME-DESIGN §7, §5.2). One file per skill at content/skills/<class>/<id>.json, where <class> is the classId (field, pet and monster skills under those folders). Tier is fixed; rank 1–10 lives on the hero.

classId.description: The class id this skill belongs to, or one of the literals 'field' (a field skill, §7.6), 'pet' (a pet active, §9) or 'monster' (a skill only monsters use).

school.description: A school id from the class's schools[]; for 'field', 'pet' and 'monster' skills, the same literal as classId.

tier.description: Tier I–V (§7.2). Field, pet and monster-only skills use 1.

type.description: active: takes a turn and costs pool; passive: always on while equipped in a passive slot.

cost.description: Pool cost (stamina or mana by class) at rank 1. 0 for passives and for the Ultimate, which costs 100 Momentum instead (§3.2).

weight.description: Timeline weight of the action (§3.1). Required for actives; null for passives.

effects.description: What the skill does at rank 1; rankScaling grows it.

prerequisiteId.description: The Tier N−1 skill of the same school that must be known first (§7.1). null at Tier I and for field skills.

isUltimate.description: The class's one Ultimate: Tier III, 100 Momentum, never misses (§7.1).

monsterTechniqueOf.description: Monster id whose move this is; such a skill only Insights while that monster uses it (§7.5). null for ordinary skills.

requirements.description: Equipment the skill needs in hand. Omit when none.

shield.description: Needs a shield in the off hand (Shield Slam).

weaponTypes.description: Needs one of these weapon types in the main hand (Executioner: greatsword or greataxe).

twoHanded.description: Needs a two-handed weapon in both hands.

rankScaling.description: Per-rank change as signed percentages of the rank-1 value (§5.2 default: +4% effect, −2% cost).

effects.description: Lines added or replacing at rank 10.

tags.description: What the skill is for; the Skill Hall's 'Recommended loadout' and the AI read these.

xpTags.description: Attributes a meaningful use of this skill trains (§5.2). Luck is never trainable.

aiHints.description: How a gambit or the balance runner's scripted policy should treat this skill.

priority.description: 0 never picked on auto, 100 always first.
